text.aria-label: Subtitle text '13 Primary substations with at least 24 months of data, January 2022 to June 2026. Residual: observed power minus experiment 17's model frozen at its first origin, ERA5 weather. One dot per series and month, runs of July 2025 to June 2026 (experiment 24).'
text.tspan: 13 Primary substations with at least 24 months of data, January 2022 to June 2026. Residual:
observed power minus experiment 17's model frozen at its first origin, ERA5 weather.
One dot per series and month, runs of July 2025 to June 2026 (experiment 24).
